captions:
Just a quick start before the world wakes up.
Before her hectic list of daily chores can take over, Isla steals a steady moment with her grid.

No point stressing over things I can't speed up.
As the train falls behind schedule, she tunes out the delay and stays focused on her puzzle.

Just three minutes to think. Nobody needs me right now.
Setting her phone face down on the table, she carves out a tiny oasis of pure steady.

Check the daily rule before trusting it.
The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.

There we go. That actually makes the rest of the day feel doable.
With the constraint solved, the solution clicks into place and her mind instantly feels lighter.

That's enough for now. Time to head back out.
She closes her notebook with a soft sigh, ready to step back into the busy afternoon.
